[EN] I don't know what's happening. The kulkaris and their allies have never been this hostile before. I mean, I suffer no delusions that we had an alliance, but really.

Everything's different now. We can't just sit around and wait for them to take us out. We need to take action.

Get rid of the {@LinkCreature:18#1#Desert Fire thrashers} and {@LinkCreature:18#2#Desert Fire shamans}. Go see {@LinkCreature:218#1003#Kardelen} at Camp Marrakeen when you've finished.
[ES] No sé qué está pasando. Los kulkaris y sus aliados nunca habían sido tan hostiles. O sea, no me hago ilusiones de que tuviéramos una alianza, pero de verdad.

Todo es diferente ahora. No podemos quedarnos de brazos cruzados a esperar a que nos eliminen. Debemos tomar medidas.

Deshazte de los {@LinkCreature:18#1#Desert Fire thrashers} y {@LinkCreature:18#2#Desert Fire shamans}. Ve a ver a {@LinkCreature:218#1003#Kardelen} en Camp Marrakeen cuando hayas terminado.

[EN] Got rid of the kulkaris, did you? Glad to hear it—I needed a break!

I remember when my biggest complaint was boredom. Be careful what you wish for, eh?
[ES] ¿Te deshiciste de los kulkaris? Me alegra oírlo, ¡necesitaba un respiro!

Recuerdo cuando mi mayor queja era el aburrimiento. Ten cuidado con lo que deseas, ¿eh?
